name: Aleef

Checked app-rescue path since an iOS/Android app exists (io.onemobile.alemadigroup): WebSearch confirms only '10+ downloads' on Google Play, far below the 50,000+ threshold, so no rescue applies.

name: Ali Bin Ali Group
category: diversified holding conglomerate (retail/distribution + hospitality, travel, logistics, contracting, mall management, medical distribution, printing)
reason: Genuinely Doha, Qatar-HQ'd since 1945 (geography confirmed) and does operate real approved-category retail arms (Monoprix hypermarkets -- 6 Qatar stores, Galeries Lafayette Doha department store, Ali Bin Ali Luxury, ABA Fashion, consumer electronics distribution). However alibinali.com itself is a pure corporate 'About us / Business Streams / Media Room / Careers / Contact' site -- no cart, no products, no linked owned online store anywhere on the domain, and the group's business-stream list mixes that retail activity with multiple explicit Gate 2 hard-fail lines (Mall Management = real estate/landlord; International Travel & Tourism = hospitality/travel; Logistics and Contracting & Property Management = B2B/construction services; Medical = B2B equipment distribution; Printing Press = manufacturing), so the entity as presented on this domain is not cleanly one of the approved categories. WebSearch further confirms Monoprix Qatar's online orders are fulfilled via the third-party Snoonu delivery marketplace rather than an owned D2C storefront or app, so no owned transactional channel is confirmed either. Re-verification overturns prior IN.
